# jamfplatform_ai_governance_policy (List Resource)

Lists Jamf AI Governance policies, for `terraform query` and for importing existing policies in bulk. Archived policies are never returned.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `ai-policies:read` |



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `schema_drift_only` (Boolean) When true, return only policies whose settings schema version is behind the one Jamf now offers for their tool — the policies worth reviewing after a tool publishes a new schema.
